task: Ice Breaker practice, the greeting: greet the Toastmaster, members and guests, then say the title of your speech and one sentence about what it is about. Speak for about one minute.
say: Toastmaster, fellow Toastmasters and guests, good evening.
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——开场问候：向主持人、会员和嘉宾问好，然后说出演讲题目，并用一句话介绍演讲内容。讲一分钟左右。

task: Ice Breaker practice, the opening: start your speech with a surprising fact about yourself, then say what your speech is about. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: Here is something most people don't know about me.
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——开头：用一个关于你自己的惊人事实开场，然后说明演讲内容。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, the opening: start your speech with a question to the audience, pause, then link the question to your own life. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: Have you ever packed your whole life into two suitcases?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——开头：用一个向观众提出的问题开场，停顿一下，再把这个问题和你自己的经历联系起来。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, where I grew up: describe your home town for one to two minutes. Talk about what you could see, hear and eat there.
say: Where did you grow up?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——成长的地方：用一到两分钟描述你的家乡，说说在那里能看到、听到和吃到什么。

task: Ice Breaker practice, childhood: tell one clear memory from your childhood for one to two minutes. Say when it happened, what happened and why you still remember it.
say: What is one memory from your childhood that you will never forget?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——童年：用一到两分钟讲一段清晰的童年回忆。说明什么时候发生的、发生了什么，以及为什么你至今还记得。

task: Ice Breaker practice, my family: introduce your family for one to two minutes. Choose one person and tell us one thing that makes them special.
say: Tell us about your family.
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——我的家人：用一到两分钟介绍你的家人。挑一个人，说说他特别在哪里。

task: Ice Breaker practice, moving here: explain why you moved to New Zealand. Give two reasons and speak for one to two minutes.
say: Why did you decide to move to New Zealand?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——来到这里：解释你为什么搬到新西兰。给两个理由，讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, first weeks in New Zealand: tell a short funny or difficult story from your first weeks here, and what you learned from it. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: What happened in your first few weeks in New Zealand?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——刚到新西兰的几周：讲一个刚来时的有趣或困难的小故事，以及你从中学到了什么。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, life here now: talk about what you love about living in New Zealand now. Give two examples and speak for one to two minutes.
say: What do you love about your life in New Zealand?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——现在的生活：说说你现在喜欢新西兰生活的哪些方面。举两个例子，讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, my work: describe a normal working day from morning to evening. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: What does a normal day at work look like for you?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——我的工作：描述你从早到晚普通的一个工作日。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, my work: explain your IT job to someone who knows nothing about IT. Use one simple comparison from everyday life. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: So, what exactly do you do?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——我的工作：向一个完全不懂 IT 的人解释你的 IT 工作。用一个日常生活中的简单比喻。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, my career: tell us how you got into IT. Say what first made you interested and one step that took you there. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: How did you end up working in IT?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——我的职业：讲讲你是怎么进入 IT 行业的。说说最初是什么让你感兴趣，以及走到这一步的一个关键环节。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, a turning point: tell the story of one moment that changed your life. Describe life before, the moment itself, and life after. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: Was there a moment that changed everything for you?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——人生转折点：讲一个改变你人生的时刻。描述之前的生活、那个时刻本身，以及之后的生活。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, my hobby: talk about a hobby you enjoy. Say how you started and why you like it. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: What do you love doing in your free time?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——我的爱好：谈谈你喜欢的一个爱好。说说你是怎么开始的，以及为什么喜欢。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, a failure: tell us about a time you failed, how you felt, and what it taught you. Finish with one clear lesson. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: Tell us about a time things went wrong.
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——一次失败：讲一次你失败的经历、当时的感受，以及它教会了你什么。最后说出一个明确的收获。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, learning English: talk about one challenge you have had with English and how you deal with it. Keep it positive, and a little funny if you can. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: What has learning English been like for you?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——学英语：谈谈你在英语上遇到的一个困难，以及你是怎么应对的。保持积极，可以的话带点幽默。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, why I joined Toastmasters: say why you joined the club and what you hope to get from it. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: Why did you join Toastmasters?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——为什么加入 Toastmasters：说说你为什么加入俱乐部，以及希望从中收获什么。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, a person who inspired me: talk about one person who inspired you. Give one example of something they did and how it changed you. Speak for one to two minutes.
say: Who has inspired you most in your life?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——激励我的人：谈谈一个激励过你的人。举一个他做过的事的例子，以及这件事怎样改变了你。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, linking the parts: give a short version of your speech with three parts, for example home town, work and hobby. Use a clear linking sentence between each part, such as "That brings me to...". Speak for one to two minutes.
say: Let's practise moving smoothly from one part of your story to the next.
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——衔接各部分：讲一个包含三个部分的简短版演讲，比如家乡、工作和爱好。每两部分之间用一句清楚的过渡语，比如 “That brings me to...”。讲一到两分钟。

task: Ice Breaker practice, the closing: sum up your speech in two sentences, link back to your opening, and end with a strong last line before you hand back to the Toastmaster. Speak for about one minute.
say: How will you end your speech?
zh: Ice Breaker 练习——结尾：用两句话总结你的演讲，呼应开头，用一句有力的话收尾，再把话筒交还给主持人。讲一分钟左右。
